prayerExcerpt.en-US: Go into all the world, and proclaim the Gospel.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Ide pelo mundo inteiro e anunciai o Evangelho!

meta.face: Timothy (left): a slender young man of about twenty-five with a slim, narrow face and a gently pointed chin — a slender, straight nose, gentle, slightly hooded hazel eyes, thin, faintly arched brows, smooth cheeks and a soft, small mouth; short straight light-brown hair with a soft fringe, a sparse, short, fair-brown beard rounded along the jaw, and a gentle, slightly lowered gaze. Titus (right): a clean-shaven man of about forty-five with a square face — a broad, flat forehead, a short, straight nose with a broad bridge, narrow, deep-set dark eyes under thick straight black brows that nearly meet, flat cheeks, a strong square jaw and a wide, thin-lipped mouth; olive complexion, black hair cut short in a straight Roman fringe with grey at the temples, and a steady, direct gaze. Not a beardless youth, not the thirties man with brown curls.
meta.basis: The Painter's Manual gives Titus as beardless and Timothy (on his Byzantine feast, 22 January) as young with a rounded beard; Titus is made older because he was already Paul's companion at the Jerusalem meeting (Gal 2:1), before Timothy joined him (Acts 16:1), and Timothy's youth is from 1 Tim 4:12.
